transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. I came in because... well, nothing really feels like mine anymore. I used to get excited about things, you know? Checking out murals, going for runs, watching basketball... even just making a good drink at work. But now, I just stand there. It's like I don't care about any of it at all.
Have you ever experienced a period of time where you felt unusually high, energetic, or impulsive, to the point where you needed much less sleep than usual?
No, not at all. I've never really had a time where I felt super energetic or... impulsive, like you said. I definitely always need my sleep. So, no, I haven't experienced anything like that.
Have you ever felt this way for a period of two weeks or more at any point in your life before this current experience?

No, I don't think so. I mean, everyone has bad days or gets in a funk sometimes, but... never like this. This is the first time it's just stuck with me for this long. Before all this started recently, I was always pretty steady. So, no, I haven't felt this way before.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight since you started feeling this way?

Yeah, I have. I just don't really have an appetite anymore. Most days, I completely forget to eat until I'm at work and my hands actually start shaking behind the bar. Then, after closing, I might try to grab a few bites of something cold, but... I honestly just feel sick even looking at it. So, yeah, I'm definitely not eating much.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns since you started feeling this way?

Yeah, my sleep's been pretty messed up. I'll get home and lie down, and I'm exhausted, but... my head just won't shut off. I just keep going over every little mistake I made at work, over and over. And then, when I finally do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up around four or five in the morning. Once I'm up, that's it. I just can't get back to sleep.
How much difficulty are you having with your daily tasks, like working your shift at the bar or taking care of yourself at home?

It's having a pretty big impact, honestly. At the bar... well, I've actually missed several shifts lately. And when I am there, I keep making these closing mistakes that I never used to make. It's frustrating because now my coworkers are having to double-check my work, and this is stuff people always used to trust me with. 

Outside of work, it's the same story. I've completely stopped seeing my friends. We used to get together for runs, or play basketball, or go do these mural shoots, but... I just can't make myself show up anymore. I just don't have it in me to go.
When you are at work or at home, do you feel like your movements and your speech have slowed down, or do you feel a sense of restlessness that makes it hard for you to sit still?

I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't feel like I'm moving or talking any slower than usual. And I'm not really restless or pacing around, either. I just feel... tired, mostly. But physically, my movements and speech seem about the same.
Do you find that you are having a harder time than usual focusing on what you're doing or making simple decisions?

Yeah, actually, I really am. It's... it's like my brain just stalls out. Like, taking inventory used to be completely automatic for me. I could do it in my sleep. But lately, I'll just stand there staring at the bottles, and I'll lose count two or three times. And it's even with the really simple stuff. I'll just freeze up trying to decide something as basic as which garnish I need to restock first. I just can't seem to focus or make a choice.
Do you find yourself feeling like you are a burden to others or dwelling on feelings of worthlessness or guilt?

Yeah, I do. I just... I keep thinking about how I've let people down. The younger bartenders at work, they kind of look up to me, and I've been dropping the ball. And then there are these local artists I promised I'd help find space for to show their work, and I just haven't done anything about it. I feel like I'm wrecking their shot at getting noticed, and honestly... it just makes me feel like I deserve whatever bad things happen to me because of it. I just feel pretty worthless right now.
Because you mentioned feeling worthless and like you are a burden to others, I need to ask: have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living or that you would be better off dead?
No, I haven't really had thoughts like that. I mean, I feel bad about myself and how I'm handling things, but I don't want to die or anything. I just want to figure out how to fix what's going wrong.
About how many weeks has it been since you started feeling this way consistently?

It's been about two months now. Yeah, right around eight weeks. It started right after the bar was bought out. Everything I had been working toward just... got changed, and I've been feeling this way pretty consistently since then.
